name: Metadata
description: Finishes the tags on new downloads and on albums you choose: embeds the cover, saves lyrics, adds release details from MusicBrainz, cleans out junk tags, and adds ReplayGain.

settings.label: Embed covers
settings.help: Puts the album cover inside each file: the album folder's cover, or the front cover on the Cover Art Archive.

settings.label: Save lyrics files
settings.help: Saves synced lyrics from LRCLIB in an .lrc file next to each track.

settings.label: Embed lyrics
settings.help: Puts lyrics from LRCLIB inside each file: synced when LRCLIB has them, plain otherwise.

settings.label: Add release details
settings.help: Adds the release date, original date, label, catalog number, barcode, ISRC, media, release type, track and disc totals, and sort names from MusicBrainz.

settings.label: Clean tags
settings.help: Removes encoder notes, web links, purchase details, private frames, and pictures other than the cover, and old ID3v1 and APE tags. Moves MP3 tags to ID3v2.4.

settings.label: Add ReplayGain
settings.help: Measures loudness with ffmpeg and adds track and album gain, for players other than Aurral. Aurral levels volume on its own. Uses a lot of CPU.

settings.label: Replace existing values
settings.help: Off: fills in only what a file is missing. On: also replaces the cover, lyrics, release details, and ReplayGain a file already has.
